scope: Continuous thematic listening route through Guedes symbolist prose, Bernardo Soares and Lisbon office life, dreams of escape, city observation, disquiet and the absence of authorial order.
editorial_boundary: Pessoa unfinished project c.1913–35, first book assembled by editors in 1982, multiple Guedes/Soares attributions. This is not an invented sequence of source fragments, a complete reading or a retranslation of modern copyrighted English editions.
